message: EXCEPTIONAL CROSS-PROJECT BLOCKER — Jarvis browser launch transport is breaking Favn coordination (operator diagnostic, 2026-11-18). On a new empty https://chatgpt.com/ tab with Work mode selected, browser-scripts/chatgpt/launchAgent.js failed BEFORE Send: UiIncompatible:modeSelection:ChatModeUnavailable, with Chat button present aria-pressed=false, Work=true, zero user turns. Its current mode-selection logic calls selectedChat.click() ONCE as soon as React-mode buttons appear, then waits for Chat=true, without a hydration-safe retry. Independently reproduced: a fully hydrated empty diagnostic tab still had Work=true; clicking Chat once *after hydration* switched Chat=true and Work=false; another freshly opened tab inherited Chat=true; the unchanged launcher then submitted a Favn Manager prompt with matching user bubble and durable conversation URL. Please route this to the appropriate Jarvis owner for an exact, reviewed transport-only fix and regression test: wait for hydration/stable mode controls and permit bounded idempotent Work-to-Chat click retries only on same verified empty home with zero user turns, no guesses or duplicate Send. Preserve fail-closed unknown submission/cleanup semantics and do NOT broaden into Work backend, native tests or Favn source. This is a Jarvis browser UI transport bug, not a Favn compiler gate. Favn Manager is prohibited from editing Jarvis source. The current workaround is Chat mode persisted on the browser, but that is not a durable script repair.
